videos.headline: Brad Roberts rumbles his way for an Air Force TD
videos.description: Brad Roberts rumbles his way into the end zone as Air Force goes up 6-0 vs. Baylor.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Brad Roberts rumbles his way for an Air Force TD) 2022/12/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Hal Presley hauls in a Baylor TD
videos.description: Blake Shapen rolls out of the pocket and finds Hal Presley for the score as Baylor cuts it to 9-7 at the end of the first half.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Hal Presley hauls in a Baylor TD) 2022/12/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Amari Terry's 68-yard catch sets up Air Force TD
videos.description: Amari Terry hauls in a 68-yard catch to put Air Force in the red zone and Haaziq Daniels punches it in for the score to pad their lead to 16-7.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Amari Terry's 68-yard catch sets up Air Force TD) 2022/12/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Air Force almost forgets kicker on FG attempt
videos.description: Matthew Dapore scampers out to the field just in time and nails a 37-yard field goal to pad Air Force's lead to 9-0.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Air Force almost forgets kicker on FG attempt) 2022/12/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: John Lee Eldridge III hurdles defender for Air Force
videos.description: John Lee Eldridge III goes up and over a Baylor defender for a gain on the play.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (John Lee Eldridge III hurdles defender for Air Force) 2022/12/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Brad Roberts muscles his way for an Air Force TD
videos.description: Brad Roberts punches it in for the score as Air Force increases its lead to 30-7.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Brad Roberts muscles his way for an Air Force TD) 2022/12/23 ESHEET

videos.headline: Gavin Holmes weaves his way for a Baylor TD
